CustomField.description: Sandbox testing only. A made-up number, starting 000, that stands in for the person's social security number in migrated test data until Shield Platform Encryption is turned on. It is never a real number. Never deploy this field to production: the real number goes in Social Security Number.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Test data only. Not a real social security number.
CustomField.label: Mock Social Security Number
